title: Rig Relay WriteFile Invocation v1
description: Schema for a deterministic write_file tool invocation request. Defines the bounded envelope for atomic file writes.

path.description: Path to the file to write

content.description: UTF-8 content to write to the file

overwrite.description: Must be set to true to overwrite an existing file

allow_overwrite_protected.description: Set to true only when overwriting a dirty file at session start. Must be paired with expected_before_sha256.

expected_before_sha256.description: sha256:<hex> of the file bytes before writing. Required when allow_overwrite_protected=true.
